name: Buster Blade
body:
This ornate greatsword has a smaller blade built into its hilt that can be drawn and dual-wielded at a moment’s notice.

Weapon Groups: Heavy blade, light blade (see text)

Type: Exotic, two-handed slashing or double, one-handed slashing (see text).

Damage: 2d6

Crit: 19-20×2

Range: –

Weight: 7 lbs.

Special: As part of a move action, you can separate a buster blade into both a bastard sword and a short sword. Any enchantments placed on the buster blade apply to the bastard sword section only, but the short sword section can be enchanted separately. A creature with Exotic Weapon Proficiency (buster blade) can wield it properly in either form and is treated as having Two-Weapon Fighting when wielding the buster blade in sections.

The Book of many Things Volume 2: Shattered Worlds. © 2018, Samurai Sheepdog; Author: Kevin Glusing.
